pages.text: The Divine Heavenly Dao has $(l)10,000 health$(), stands $(l)about 50 blocks tall$(), drifts through terrain to hover over you, and fills the air with an oppressive hum while it lives. It is $(l)immune to all ranged attacks$() and enrages nearby Endermen.$(br2)Its attacks have a wind-up:

$(li)$(l)Earthshaker$(): a ring of sparks marks the ground, then it smashes down. Entities standing on the ground take 50 damage and are thrown 20 blocks up, so $(l)jump$() at the right moment.$(li)$(l)Heavenly Thunder$(): 18 bolts over 5 seconds, 100 damage each. $(l)One of them always strikes you$(); the rest strike nearby creatures.$(li)$(l)Heaven's Strike$(): a charged direct blow for 50 damage.

$(l)Abyss$(): it raises both hands and gathers a black orb overhead while dark mist pours into it. After 10 seconds it hurls the orb at you for a cataclysmic explosion (damage falls off over 36 blocks and is almost certainly lethal up close, and it blows up terrain). When you see the hands go up, $(l)run$() or get behind thick cover. It is not hurt by its own blast.
At low health it enters $(l)phase two$(): it heals every second, attacks faster and summons 3 dragon-sized $(l)Giant Withers$(). While they live the Boss takes half damage, so clear them first.
Drops 4-8 Heavenly Dao Fragments, Enchanted Golden Apples, a Dragon Egg and Nether Stars. Fragments craft the S-tier gear.
